summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting on June 16, 2026, partly to satisfy Nasdaq's annual meeting rule. No business other than in the proxy statement may be transacted. The meeting does not technically constitute an annual general meeting under Cayman law, so Class I director terms do not expire. The filing is a procedural step for SPAC governance, not a de-SPAC transaction. Watch for any extension or business-combination updates disclosed in the proxy.
